title: PCSO Lotto Results: Lotto 6/42 prize tops P58M as no winners in major jackpot draws on September 24
summary: There were no winners of the two major lotto draws on September 24, 2026 as the Lotto 6/42 prize rose to over P58 million, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced on Thursday.

blocks.text: There were no winners of the two major lotto draws on September 24, 2026 as the Lotto 6/42 prize rose to over P58 million, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced on Thursday.
There were no bettors who chose the winning combination of 01-36-07-23-15-03 for the Lotto 6/42 prize of P58,291,713.31.
The odds of winning the jackpot in a standard 6/42 lottery game are 1 in 5,245,786.
No one also picked the winning numbers of 30-39-34-17-47-11 to bring home the Superlotto 6/49 jackpot of P25,396,508.95.
According to the PCSO, the odds of winning the Super Lotto 6/49 jackpot are 1 in 13,983,816.
